sql.permission.getUserPermissions: select p.permission_code from flow.user_role ur inner join flow.role r on r.id = ur.role_id inner join flow.role_permission rp on rp.role_id = r.id inner join flow.permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where ur.user_id = :userId AND r.archived is not true and p.archived is not true group by p.permission_code
